---
title: "ctDNA technical validity"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

An attempted sample must have a recorded sampling date. The analysis error is
one exactly when both LOD Q1 and LOD Q3 are missing. The explicitly entered
technical-error flag is retained for QC comparison only. The Bayesian model is
sample-level with a patient random intercept, and the compact summary reports
the attempted-sample denominator.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_technical_validity"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "technical-validity-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "technical-validity-draws.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "technical-validity-posterior.svg")
model_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("analysis", "04-implementation", "models"))
model_path <- file.path(model_dir, "technical-validity.rds")
ctdna_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                        "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
if (!file.exists(ctdna_path)) stop("Technical-validity analysis requires the built ctDNA sample table.")
input_paths <- c(ctdna_path, private_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"))
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(summary_path, draws_path, figure_path, model_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "03-technical-validity.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  technical_summary <- read_result_table(summary_path)
} else {
  samples <- read_result_table(ctdna_path)
  require_public_columns(samples, c("sample_id", "id", "sample_date", "lod_q1", "lod_q3"),
                         "technical validity")
  sample_dates <- parse_analysis_date(samples$sample_date, "sample_date")
  attempted_sample <- !is.na(sample_dates)
  lod_q1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(samples$lod_q1)))
  lod_q3 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(samples$lod_q3)))
  samples$attempted_sample <- attempted_sample
  samples$ctdna_error_derived <- as.integer(
    attempted_sample & is.na(lod_q1) & is.na(lod_q3)
  )
  if ("ctdna_error" %in% names(samples)) {
    samples$ctdna_error_qc <- validate_binary(samples$ctdna_error, "ctdna_error")
  } else {
    samples$ctdna_error_qc <- NA_real_
  }
  attempted <- samples[samples$attempted_sample, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(attempted) == 0L) stop("No attempted samples have a recorded sampling date.")
  model_data <- attempted
  error_values <- validate_binary(model_data$ctdna_error_derived,
                                  "ctdna_error_derived")
  observed_summary <- data.frame(
    samples = length(unique(model_data$sample_id[!is.na(model_data$sample_id)])),
    patients = length(unique(model_data$id[!is.na(model_data$id)])),
    errors = sum(error_values == 1),
    no_error = sum(error_values == 0),
    error_rate = mean(error_values == 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (!requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'brms' is required for the clustered technical-validity model.")
  }
  fit <- brms::brm(
    stats::as.formula("ctdna_error_derived ~ 1 + (1 | id)"),
    data = model_data,
    family = brms::bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    iter = 2000,
    chains = 4,
    cores = 1,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", offset = 2L),
    refresh = 0,
    file = model_path
  )
  epred <- brms::posterior_epred(fit, newdata = model_data, re_formula = NA)
  draws <- data.frame(
    draw = rowMeans(epred),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  technical_summary <- data.frame(
    outcome = "technical_error_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(draws$draw),
    posterior_median = stats::median(draws$draw),
    lower_95 = stats::quantile(draws$draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = stats::quantile(draws$draw, 0.975),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  technical_summary$n_attempted_samples <- observed_summary$samples
  technical_summary$n_attempted_patients <- observed_summary$patients
  technical_summary$n_derived_errors <- observed_summary$errors
  technical_summary$n_derived_no_error <- observed_summary$no_error
  technical_summary$qc_flag_observed <- sum(!is.na(model_data$ctdna_error_qc))
  technical_summary$qc_flag_discordant <- sum(
    !is.na(model_data$ctdna_error_qc) &
      model_data$ctdna_error_qc != model_data$ctdna_error_derived
  )
  write_module_draws(draws, draws_path)
  write_module_table(technical_summary, summary_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the technical-validity figure.")
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(draws, ggplot2::aes(draw)) +
    ggplot2::geom_density() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Posterior technical-error probability", y = "Density") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "fit", error_definition = "both_lod_quartiles_missing"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "03-technical-validity.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: technical-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Technical validity summary"

technical_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
